_comment: Tier-1 manual layout overrides. Optional: delete or use {} for pure auto layout. All distances are millimetres on the page (viewBox 0 0 297 210). Keys: stops by ATCO, POIs by 'cat:name', linear features by their routes.json feature 'key', external branches by route (or route#n). Author by dragging in the editor (node edit-server.js) or by hand. Re-applied on every regenerate, so it survives data refreshes.
_routeColors_comment: TOP-LEVEL (applies to BOTH maps): recolour a route everywhere, e.g. when two route colours are too similar. Overrides the routes.json palette for that route on the internal and external maps together.

internal._stops_comment: stops[ATCO].pos moves the PHYSICAL stop for EVERY route through it.
internal._routeStops_comment: PER-ROUTE stop positions: routeStops[route][ATCO].pos moves the stop ONLY on that route's drawn line, so editing one route never drags another that shares the stop. Where a route diverges, that shared stop shows as a tick on each line.
internal._routeOffsets_comment: Lateral spread: nudge a whole route's line sideways (page mm) off a shared corridor; stop dots stay put.
internal._align_comment: Straighten a run of stops on ONE route (per-route, never global). stops[]: the exact stops to straighten (route order). mode 'project' (default) keeps natural spacing; 'even' distributes equally. snap: octolinear angle. Legacy {from,to} (no stops[]) straightens the whole span between them.
internal._features_comment: Hand-adjust linear features by their routes.json 'key'. hide: drop the whole feature. move{dx,dy}: nudge feature+label together. segments: array of page-mm polylines that REPLACE the projected geometry (the Tube-map straighten — lay a run dead-straight); points: a single such polyline. style: merged over the per-type default (e.g. recolour). label{pos|offset,anchor,text,hide}: reposition/retitle/suppress just the label.
